authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/nord/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/nord/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI controller list, with its printed name, sent as the control change it prints on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The list prints controller numbers only: every value is 0 - 127, and a setting chosen from a list (a model, a waveform, an effect type) is a number here, not a choice.

The manual: panel controls send their controllers on the Global MIDI channel, to and from the Slot in focus (the Slot buttons; Slot Focus is CC 119); a Slot's own MIDI channel reaches that Slot only. Set the channel variable to whichever is to be edited.
The manual: an on/off button is 0 off and 127 on; a button that steps through settings starts at 0 and goes up in equal steps.

Left out, the pedals, the wheel and bank select: 7 Volume Pedal (transmits if enabled as Volume in System menu), 11 Ctrl Pedal (transmits if enabled as Morph in System menu), 1 Mod Wheel, 11 Wheel/Pedal Morph (incoming CC), 64 Sustain Pedal, 0 Bank Select MSB, 32 Bank Select LSB.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same messages when its panel is used, where its MIDI settings allow
